description: Returns a list of tracks with rich search and discovery capabilities. Supports filtering by ids, names, tags, audio format, licensing, and many other criteria. Includes special fields like audiodownload_allowed, audio, audiodownload, and optional includes (licenses, musicinfo, stats, lyrics). Note that "audiodownload" will be empty if audiodownload_allowed is false. The default limit is 10 (max 200), and the default order is relevance. Use the 'order' parameter carefully as any non‑relevance first order will discard the relevance ranking. The 'include' parameter can be used to append extra objects to each track.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The results formatting type.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Ignored for non‑JSON formats or non‑GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. "all" is treated as 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction; most rating orders default to descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes total number of rows without limit/offset. Use sparingly for performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A track name.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search a track by name (wild‑card). Provide UTF‑8 string.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Select only tracks of a certain type. Default is albumtrack.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs.

parameters.name: album_name
parameters.description: Album name filter.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs.

parameters.name: artist_name
parameters.description: Artist name filter.

parameters.name: content_id_free
parameters.description: Content ID free filter.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Released between dates (format yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Filter for tracks selected by Jamendo team.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Cover image size in pixels.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio streaming format.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format; defaults to audioformat or mp32.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Search by one or more tags (AND semantics).

parameters.name: fuzzytags
parameters.description: Search by tags with OR semantics.

parameters.name: acousticelectric
parameters.description: Filter by acoustic or electric.

parameters.name: vocalinstrumental
parameters.description: Filter by vocal or instrumental.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender of the singer.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Track speed categories.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Lyrics language (ISO 639‑1 code).

parameters.name: durationbetween
parameters.description: Track duration range in seconds, formatted as min_max.

parameters.name: xartist
parameters.description: Find tracks similar to a non‑Jamendo artist.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free‑text search across track, album, artist and tags.

parameters.name: prolicensing
parameters.description: Only tracks available for single‑track commercial licensing.

parameters.name: probackground
parameters.description: Only tracks available for background‑music commercial licensing.

parameters.name: ccsa
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons Share‑Alike licensed tracks.

parameters.name: ccnd
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons No‑Derivs licensed tracks.

parameters.name: ccnc
parameters.description: Filter for Creative Commons Non‑Commercial licensed tracks.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Append additional objects to each track result.

parameters.name: groupby
parameters.description: Aggregate results by artist or album, returning a single track per group.

parameters.name: boost
parameters.description: Boost specific rating when performing a search; used together with 'order'.

notes: The 'order' parameter defaults to relevance; any non‑relevance first order discards relevance ranking.
Maximum limit is 200; using "all" still caps at 200.
If 'audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'audiodownload' field returns an empty string.
When 'type' is omitted only album tracks are returned by default to avoid breaking older applications.
The 'fullcount' parameter incurs performance cost and should be used only when needed.
